FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = d.striker_id

  AND ((m.team1 = 'India' AND m.team2 = 'England') OR (m.team1 = 'England' AND m.team2 = 'India'))
  AND m.series_name LIKE '%tour of India%'
  AND d.batting_team = 'India'
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY runs DESC, p.player_name ASC
LIMIT 5;

  SELECT
    team2 AS team_name,
    COUNT(*) AS away_matches,
    SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS away_wins

LIMIT 1;
